logline: A man tests his shadow in an abandoned hallway and discovers it has been testing him back.
story: Five beats: a whisper in a moonlit hallway, a shadow that lags, a flashlight that dies, a merge, and a twist in the dark.

characters.name: Leo
characters.look: thin 2D stickman, bone-white line art, hollow head, white pinprick eyes in the dark, dying flashlight

characters.name: The Shadow
characters.look: solid pitch-black 2D silhouette, no eyes, peels off the floor, mimics Leo

base.style: kaomei A1 Classic Minimalist (Dark), textured charcoal, bone-white line art

shots.title: The Hallway
shots.prompt: kaomei Classic Minimalist Dark, high-contrast 2D: A shaft of moonlight cuts across a decaying hallway floor. Leo steps cautiously into the beam, dying flashlight in hand, and whispers.
shots.speaker: leo

shots.title: The Discrepancy
shots.prompt: kaomei Classic Minimalist Dark, high-contrast 2D: Leo turns toward a dark doorway. On the wallpaper his shadow turns too - except its head stays facing forward. It snaps back a beat too late.

shots.title: The Corner
shots.prompt: kaomei Classic Minimalist Dark, high-contrast 2D: The flashlight clicks dead. Leo backs against the wall. In the moonlight his shadow tilts up off the floorboards and rises into a solid black figure with no eyes.

shots.title: The Merge
shots.prompt: kaomei Classic Minimalist Dark, high-contrast 2D: The shadow lunges into Leo's chest. A sharp thud, then silence. Leo looks down at his hands, whole and alone, and gasps for breath.
shots.speaker: leo

shots.title: The Twist
shots.prompt: kaomei Classic Minimalist Dark, high-contrast 2D: Leo steps into the dark hallway. Two white pinprick eyes open on his face. Behind him, in the moonlight, a flat Leo lies on the floor clawing silently at the boards.
